Privacy Policy

 1. Data Collection
 • This app only processes notifications from your device's default SMS app
 • We do not collect or process notifications from any other apps
 • All data processing happens locally on your device


2. Data Storage
 • Any stored data is encrypted using the Android KeyStore system
 • We use AES-256 encryption with GCM mode for maximum security
 • Data is stored only in your app's private storage


3. Data Usage
 • SMS notifications are processed only for app functionality
 • No data is transmitted to external servers
 • No analytics or tracking systems are used


4. Your Rights
 • You can revoke notification access at any time
 • You can delete all stored data from app settings
 • You can uninstall the app to remove all data


5. Security Measures
 • Advanced encryption for all stored data
 • Secure coding practices and regular security updates
 • Protection against unauthorized access


6. Contact
 For any privacy concerns, please contact support at:
 privacy@example.com
